description: L2 anchor receipt emitted by anchor-cron after an MST root has been committed to EtzhayyimAnchor on Base L2. Per ADR-2605171800 Stage 5b. Closes the substrate pipeline: mst-projector (rootCid) → ipfs-pinner (carCid pinned) → anchor-cron (rootHash anchored on Base). The on-chain `Anchored` event carries the same rootHash + ipfsCid; this AT record cross-references that event back to the originating `ipfsPin` record so any third party can trace a shard's full custody chain without trusting a single operator.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this anchor covers, copied from the originating ipfsPin record. e.g. `com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.post`.

rootCid.description: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor). Matches `com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot.rootCid` + `com.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin.rootCid`.

rootHash.description: 0x-prefixed bytes32 = sha256(rootCid as UTF-8 bytes). Primary key in EtzhayyimAnchor.anchors mapping.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed Base L2 transaction hash of the EtzhayyimAnchor.anchor() call. May be the zero-hash if anchor-cron observed the root was already on-chain from a prior tick and skipped the redundant tx (alreadyAnchored=true).

blockNumber.description: L2 block number at which the anchor landed (or the block of the prior anchor when alreadyAnchored=true).

logIndex.description: Index of the Anchored event in the receipt logs. Defaults to 0 when alreadyAnchored=true (no new event).

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id. Base mainnet = 8453, Base sepolia = 84532.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed EtzhayyimAnchor contract address on the target chain.

anchorer.description: 0x-prefixed EOA that signed the anchor tx (= msg.sender on-chain). Off-chain DID resolution is the reader's responsibility.

batchSize.description: Informational record count passed to EtzhayyimAnchor.anchor() (block.batchSize on-chain). For substrate-mode anchors this is the originating shardSnapshot.recordCount when known, else 1.

alreadyAnchored.description: True when anchor-cron detected the rootHash was already anchored on-chain from a prior tick and skipped the redundant tx. The receipt still gets recorded so readers see a complete trail.

ipfsPinUri.description: AT URI of the originating `com.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin` record. Required when the anchor was driven by substrate mode; absent when an external integrator submitted the anchor without an ipfsPin record on PDS.
